Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting certain manufacturing research and development activities from business and occupation taxation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting certain manufacturing research anddevelopment activities from business and occupation taxation; adding anew section to chapter 82.04 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) This chapter does not apply to the value of productsmanufactured pursuant to a licensing agreement entered into on or afterJuly 1, 2011, but before July 1, 2015, with the University ofWashington or Washington State University when such products are theresult of research and development activities conducted by eitheruniversity or both. This exemption only applies during the first fiveyears of production of the product. (b) A person claiming an exemption under this section must keep andmaintain records for the period required by RCW 82.32.070 establishinghis or her right to the exemption. In addition, the person claimingthe exemption must file a complete annual survey with the departmentunder RCW 82.32.585. p. 1 SHB 1943 (2) Beginning in 2014, the department, in consultation with theUniversity of Washington and Washington State University, asapplicable, must review the tax exemption program created under thissection and report its findings to the governor and the appropriatecommittees of the legislature. The report is required by December 1stof the year following any year in which one or more persons claim taxexemptions under this section. The report must include the amount ofthe tax revenue forgone, the number of businesses claiming theexemption, the number of employment positions created by thesebusinesses, the number of new products or research projects, and thenumber of trademarks, patents, and copyrights associated with theproducts manufactured under the applicable licensing agreement. (3) For the purposes of this section, "research and development"has the same meaning as provided in RCW 82.63.010.
